title: The memo itself
rule: The page is the agent's memo slip, both sides, the incident told in his notes, crossings-out and one doodle.
made: the memo slip drawn full-page in the shared pen hand (penlib.letter_lines via pen99, penlib.brush_line): torn pad edge, printed head 'MEMO / Randolph Sta. / C.V.RY.', ruled lines; the back of the slip below it
the canon memo text '4:15 - open SERVICE door. Key in cupboard.' as his pencil, then his later pencil notes E1-E5 quoting the four canon lines verbatim
three crossings-out (4:12 -> 4:10; desk -> cupboard; 'Came for: stamps, ledger, lamp oil ?')
one doodle: the brass key on its hook with the SERVICE tag and a question mark, set small in the back's lower right where no show-through falls

the front's pencil showing through the back: mirror-reversed about the slip's vertical centre (lines start at the back's right margin), faint (darkest show-through pixel capped at Lab L 200 of 255), kept clear of the doodle (hard box) and of a thin halo round his back notes; the same layer in beats b05-b07; folio by pen99.folio

events.E0: front: '4:15 - open SERVICE door. Key in cupboard.'; 'Got up from desk to fetch it.'
events.E1: front: 'Lady at window, platform side:' + the question quoted
events.E2: front: 'Looked at the clock: (4:12 struck) 4:10.' + the answer quoted
events.E3: front: 'She: "Much obliged!" and off she went.'
events.E4: back: 'Went on to the (desk struck) cupboard. Opened it. Key there on its hook, tag says SERVICE.' + doodle
events.E5: back: 'Stood there, pencil to chin:' + the forgetting line; guesses crossed out; 'Key still on hook. Door still shut.'

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

beat: the slip is written on: from the bare 4:15 errand, note by note down the front, over to the back, the doodle, the forgetting line, the crossed-out guesses
beat_frames: b01: the slip with only the 4:15 errand (E0)
b02: + got up, the lady's question (E1)
b03: + the clock, 4:12 crossed out to 4:10, his answer (E2)
b05: back of slip: cupboard (desk crossed out), key on hook, the doodle (E4)
b07: + 'Came for:' guesses crossed out; 'Key still on hook. Door still shut.'

show_through.mirrored: horizontal flip about the slip's vertical centre (x=1100)
show_through.in_beats: b05-b07 built with the same layer

self_check.check: A reader says the page is the memo, and finds E0-E5 in its notes (maker's judgement from the full-size page; blind reading pending)
self_check.evidence: measured (size, bytes) and perceptually judged (from frames) by the maker
